title: Mizzen task contract
description: A versioned task contract: the goal, the semantic scope, the input snapshot, the budget, the permissions, and the acceptance criteria. `parseTaskContract` in `src/tasks/contract.ts` validates against this schema, fills the defaults, and computes the snapshot id. Unknown versions and unknown fields are refused with their JSON Pointer. Parsing is local: no network, no model, no clock, no site read.

idempotencyKey.description: The caller's key for one registration. Repeating it with the same content resolves to the same task; repeating it with different content is a conflict.

goal.description: The task in one sentence. Surrounding whitespace is removed when parsed.

scope.description: The pages, blocks, collections, symbols, and files the task may touch.

snapshot.description: SHA-256 hashes of the effective content, data, config, and tooling. The snapshot id is derived from them.

budget.description: Independent limits for context tokens, tool calls, and time.

permissions.description: Principals allowed to read, write, or run checks. Omitted means public read and no writes or checks.

acceptance.description: Executable criteria: each names an existing check or explicitly requires human review.

scope.description: Semantic references the task may touch. At least one entry across the five lists is required.

pages.description: Page URLs, source paths, or page ids.

symbols.description: Exported symbol names, such as `build` or `Site.page`.

files.description: Files relative to the site root, with forward slashes.

content.description: SHA-256 of the effective page content after includes and overrides.

data.description: SHA-256 of the effective data the task may read.

config.description: SHA-256 of the effective site configuration.

tooling.description: SHA-256 of the engine and tool versions the task was planned with.

id.description: SHA-256 over the four hashes. Omitted on input; the parser computes and verifies it.

contextTokens.description: Most estimated context tokens the task may use.

toolCalls.description: Most tool calls the task may make.

timeMs.description: Most milliseconds the task may run.

read.description: Principals allowed to read the task; `*` means any. Default `["*"]`.

write.description: Principals allowed to request writes for the task; `*` means any. Default `[]`.

check.description: Principals allowed to request checks for the task; `*` means any. Default `[]`.

id.description: Stable criterion id, unique in the task.

statement.description: What must be true. Surrounding whitespace is removed when parsed.

check.description: The id of an existing check that proves the criterion.

review.description: Explicitly requires human review; the criterion is never proved automatically.

reference.description: A page URL, source path, or page id.

symbol.description: An exported symbol name, optionally dotted.

principal.description: A reader, writer, or checker identity; `*` means any.

hash.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

path.description: A relative path with forward slashes: no leading slash, drive letter, backslash, or `..` segment.
